cohort: 71 patients who underwent vaginal radical trachelectomy for early invasive uterine cervical cancer and desired to maintain their fertility, of whom 21 became pregnant
finding: Vaginal radical trachelectomy appears to be a safe and feasible option for young patients with early invasive uterine cervical cancer who desire to maintain their fertility, with favorable obstetrical and oncological prognoses.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed for all pregnancies after vaginal radical trachelectomy.
